hooks.description: Warn when a file exceeds 300 lines after editing
Warn when a plain JavaScript file is written - prefer TypeScript
Warn on console.log left in TypeScript/JavaScript files
hooks.matcher: tool_name in ['Write', 'Edit'] and (file_path.endswith('.ts') or file_path.endswith('.tsx') or file_path.endswith('.js'))

hooks.description: Warn when a new branch has no ticket ID
Remind to run checks before committing
Block direct push to main or master
Warn when pushing without running tests first
Session recap - print changed files and project state after Claude stops

hooks.command:
bash -c '
echo ""
echo "════════════════════════════════════════"
echo "  SESSION RECAP"
echo "════════════════════════════════════════"
echo ""
echo "── Branch & last commit ──"
git log --oneline -1 2>/dev/null || echo "(not a git repo)"
git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null
echo ""
echo "── Files changed ──"
git diff --stat HEAD 2>/dev/null
git status --short 2>/dev/null
echo ""
echo "── Files approaching 300-line limit ──"
find . -not -path "*/.git/*" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -not -path "*/.next/*" \( -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.tsx" -o -name "*.js" -o -name "*.jsx" \) | xargs wc -l 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | awk "\$1 >= 250 && \$2 != \"total\"" | head -10
echo ""
echo "════════════════════════════════════════"
echo ""
'
